text:
maria: Quick sync — we need to decide how the Console shows sampled request/response payloads. Compliance says no raw PII in UI by default. Options: (A) preview only with strong redaction + 'request unmask' workflow that creates an auditable ticket; (B) never show PII in UI, only hashed fingerprints, full replay available only in gated audit environment. thoughts?
kevin: leaning to A as it's better for debugging, but must have strict RBAC + TTL for unmask. temp unmask should expire and leave an audit trail.
sasha: agree on A if we can guarantee the redactor covers emails/phones/SSNs. current regex covers common emails but phone formats are messy. also we should show a redaction legend in the UI so engineers know what's been removed.
noah: sampling nuance: if we sample 0.5% of traffic and include unredacted payloads in that sample, a burst could leak lots of PII. we must ensure sampled items are fully scrubbed before any storage or UI exposure, unless explicitly unmasked via the audit flow.
maria: today some legacy routes bypass the scrub pipeline and go straight to indexing for speed. that's the risky bit.
ops-bot: deploy: scrubber-v2 deployed to staging at 08:12 UTC — verify pipeline integration.
kevin: proposal: make 'scrubbed=true' a hard precondition for ingest into the telemetry index. entries that fail scrub should be rejected or routed to a quarantine stream and flagged. allowlist for exceptions only with legal + security sign-off.
sasha: UX idea: show masked preview with explicit placeholders, like "Hello, user@[REDACTED]" and a small 'why was this redacted?' tooltip linking to policy. 'Request unmask' -> creates audit ticket and increments a rate-limited counter.
julian: for correlation we should store a deterministic HMAC fingerprint of PII (tenant-scoped key) so we can join traces without exposing raw values. key rotation must be considered.
noah: also add a quota/rate cap on 'unmask' requests per user/team to prevent abuse; default 5/day with ops override for oncall.
maria: operational metrics we need: scrub_failures, unmask_requests_total, unmask_approvals, quarantine_count. ensure these metrics contain zero PII (route id + error code only).
kevin: i'll draft an RFC: enforce scrubbed precondition, introduce unmask audit workflow, rate limits, HMAC fingerprinting, and scrub_failures metric. will include rollout steps and canary plan.
sasha: can the RFC include a small UI mock for the preview + request flow? that helps product/security alignment.
maria: yes i can add a short mock. target: PR by EOW, canary next week.
noah: one more: telemetry sampling config should default to 'store only scrubbed payloads' and we should add a small DB flag to mark which routes are allowlisted for raw ingestion (rare). audit all allowlists quarterly.
julian: note on HMAC: use tenant-specific key derived from KMS, store only the fingerprint in telemetry. add key-rotation doc.
kevin: sounds good. i'll post the RFC link here once i have a draft. ping me for reviews. :thumbsup: 
maria: thanks all — will assemble notes into the RFC and tag security/legal for allowlist criteria.
ops-bot: ticket created: ENG-telemetry-1124 "UI unmask flow + scrub enforcement"
